## Required software equipment {#required-software-equipment .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

 

 

The following table provides information on the tools you require to work with RC series 40.

+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| SW Name                                                                 | Purpose                                                                                                                    | Costs           | Remarks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

| For RC5-6: CODESYS Development System V3 3.5.21.40 - 32 bit             | IEC 61131-3 Programming Tool                                                                                               | Free of charge  | Link for installation: [-CODESYS v3.5.21.40](https://store-archive.codesys.com/ftp_download/3S/CODESYS/300000/3.5.21.40/CODESYS%203.5.21.40.exe){.weblink target="_blank"}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                                                         |                                                                                                                            |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                         |                                                                                                                            |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                         |                                                                                                                            |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| For RC18-12 & RC27-18: CODESYS Development System V3 3.5.21.40 - 32 bit |                                                                                                                            |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| CAN-USB Driver                                                          | Required if Rexroth CAN-USB is used.                                                                                       | Free of charge  | The drivers for the Bosch Rexroth CAN-USB can be downloaded at [myRexroth](https://www.boschrexroth.com/de/de/produkte/produktgruppen/mobilhydraulik/mobilelektronik/bodas-hardware/zubehor/kabel-und-stecker){.weblink target="_blank"}.                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| easyConfig                                                              | Online tool for the configuration of the basic software BODAS BSW.                                                         | Free of charge  | Refer to [myBODAS](https://www.boschrexroth.com/en/xc/products/product-groups/mobile-hydraulics-and-electronics/topics/mybodas/){.weblink target="_blank"}  and easyConfig documentation for details.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| BODAS-service 4.x.                                                      | A tool for flashing, configuration, parametrization and diagnostics of controllers as well as other Bosch Rexroth devices. | Chargeable      | The license can be ordered at [myRexroth](https://www.boschrexroth.com/de/de/produkte/produktgruppen/mobilhydraulik/mobilelektronik/bodas-software/bodas-tools/bodas-service-4-x){.weblink target="_blank"}.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

BODAS-service 4.x is a prerequisite |
